title: Taiwan’s international enrolment up by 17% in 2025/26
description:
Taiwan’s foreign enrolment grew to 140,420 in 2025/26 – a +17% increase from the previous year and an all-time record. The lion’s share of foreign students are in degree programmes (roughly 90,000).
